I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  a
 - input  b
 - output q
 - output state

The module should implement a sequential circuit. The circuit consists of
combinational logic and one bit of memory (i.e., one flip-flop). The
output of the flip-flop has been made observable through the output
state. Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of
the clock.

Read the simulation waveforms to determine what the circuit does, then
implement it.

No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI."},"current":{"revision_id":"c1f16c76-f5cb-48ec-9b20-61ed0fa76d24","source_sha256":"4e629f387076412f7c3cc580418401650078e49422d5e996f89b713392932e77","source":"
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  a,
    input  b,
    output q,
    output state
);

    reg ff;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        ff <= a ^ b ^ ff;
    end

    assign state = ff;
    assign q = a ^ b ^ ff;

endmodule

function.name: edit_dut
function.description: Replace only the current single DUT. Supply its expected revision. Does not run verification.

function.name: verify_rtl
function.description: Verify the current revision with its registered test suite through compilation, elaboration, simulation and synthesis.

function.name: read_current_rtl
function.description: Read the current DUT and verification state.

function.description: Retrieve at most two applicable validated rules. Disabled in groups A and B.
